build_GeneralizedRCNN_from_config: build a GeneralizedRCNN model from a detectron2 config with backbone, proposal generator, and ROI heads
run_GeneralizedRCNN_forward_training: run the GeneralizedRCNN forward pass in training mode to compute detection and proposal losses
run_GeneralizedRCNN_inference: run inference with GeneralizedRCNN on batched inputs to get predicted instances with boxes and classes
build_ProposalNetwork_from_config: build a ProposalNetwork model from config that only predicts object proposals using a backbone and RPN
visualize_GeneralizedRCNN_training_propo: visualize training proposals by overlaying ground truth boxes and predicted proposals on input images
